description: This is a Java source file defining the JpaAttributeDao class, which implements data access operations for attribute key-value entities in a SQL database within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: JpaAttributeDao
classes.description: Data access object for attribute key-value entities, implementing CRUD and batch operations with support for asynchronous processing and transaction management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the blocking queue for batch processing of attribute entities after construction.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by destroying the queue before shutdown.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute entry by tenant, entity, scope, and key.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves multiple attribute entries by tenant, entity, scope, and a collection of keys.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute entries for a given tenant, entity, and scope.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of attribute key-value entities based on entity ID, attribute type, and key.

methods.name: findAllKeysByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute keys associated with a specific device profile or tenant.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute keys for a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndScope
methods.description: Retrieves attribute keys for multiple entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAndScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves attribute keys for multiple entities filtered by scope.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndScope
methods.description: Retrieves the latest attribute entries for a list of entities and scope.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAndScopeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the latest attribute entries for entities and scope.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an attribute key-value entry asynchronously, adding it to the processing queue.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Adds an attribute entity to the batch processing queue.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes specified attribute keys for an entity asynchronously.

methods.name: removeAllWithVersions
methods.description: Removes attribute keys and returns their versions asynchronously.

methods.name: removeAllByEntityId
methods.description: Removes all attributes for a given entity ID within a transaction.

methods.name: getAttributeKvCompositeKey
methods.description: Constructs a composite key for attribute key-value entities.
